message.companionmod.busy: Give me a second to think...
dialogue.companionmod.t0.0: Oh... hi. We barely know each other yet.
dialogue.companionmod.t0.1: I'm Kitty. Don't mind the bells, they jingle on their own.
dialogue.companionmod.t0.2: Are you always this quiet? Okay, I'll try too.
dialogue.companionmod.t0.3: The world is big and a bit scary. But it feels calmer with you.
dialogue.companionmod.t0.4: Bring me a flower and I might melt.
dialogue.companionmod.t1.0: Oh, it's you! I thought you forgot about me.
dialogue.companionmod.t1.1: You know, I like watching you build. Even if I don't understand any of it.
dialogue.companionmod.t1.2: Meow! That was me saying hello. Don't ask.
dialogue.companionmod.t1.3: Today is a good day for an adventure, isn't it?
dialogue.companionmod.t1.4: Stay close, okay? I feel calmer that way.
dialogue.companionmod.t2.0: You became one of the most important people to me. Just don't get cocky.
dialogue.companionmod.t2.1: Remember when we first met? I was so lost.
dialogue.companionmod.t2.2: If not for you, I'd still be wandering these woods alone.
dialogue.companionmod.t2.3: Let's sit by a fire sometime and just be quiet together?
dialogue.companionmod.t2.4: I'm proud of how far we've come.
dialogue.companionmod.t3.0: With you I'm home, wherever we are.
dialogue.companionmod.t3.1: You're my best friend. Don't you dare forget it!
dialogue.companionmod.t3.2: I promise: wherever you go, I'll walk beside you. And protect you if needed.
dialogue.companionmod.t3.3: The bells on my headband ring happier when you're near.
dialogue.companionmod.t3.4: Thank you for being here. Seriously.
ambient.companionmod.rain.0: Rain... I love the sound, but my ears are getting wet.
ambient.companionmod.rain.1: Maybe we should wait it out under a roof? I'm not made of sugar, but still.
ambient.companionmod.rain.2: Raindrops on my bells make a melody. Listen!
ambient.companionmod.night.0: It's dark already. Stay close, okay?
ambient.companionmod.night.1: Nights get creepy. But you'll protect me, right?
ambient.companionmod.night.2: Do you hear that? Something is rustling in the dark...
ambient.companionmod.hurt.0: I... don't feel so good. Maybe some food?
ambient.companionmod.hurt.1: Ow... everything hurts. Please give me something to eat.
ambient.companionmod.stars.0: Look at all those stars! Sometimes it feels like each one is waiting for us.
ambient.companionmod.stars.1: I made a wish. I won't tell you, or it won't come true.
ambient.companionmod.stars.2: Beautiful night. Thanks for sitting with me.
ambient.companionmod.campfire.0: The fire crackles, so cozy... I could purr.
ambient.companionmod.campfire.1: It's warm here. Let's stay a little longer?
ambient.companionmod.campfire.2: You know, the best evenings are exactly like this: a campfire and you.
scene.companionmod.l1.0: Um... can I tell you something? I think we're friends now.
scene.companionmod.l1.1: I gathered some cookies for you. Don't ask where from.
scene.companionmod.l1.2: Don't eat them all at once, okay? Meow.
scene.companionmod.l2.0: You know, I hesitated for a long time, but now I can say: you're very dear to me.
scene.companionmod.l2.1: Here, golden apples. I was saving them for a special occasion.
scene.companionmod.l2.2: And yes, this is a special occasion. Just don't tell anyone.
scene.companionmod.l3.0: I want you to know: you're the best person I've ever met.
scene.companionmod.l3.1: Here, take these. Found them in a cave when you weren't looking. Diamonds!
scene.companionmod.l3.2: Thank you for every moment by my side. Let's have many more adventures together!
